title: The Last Light
lines: At Lanternwood's edge, a vast winged shadow cuts across the sky. One copper scale falls beside your empty lantern; your village has vanished into the mist.
You follow the scale's warm glow and catch the forest's last spark. Your lantern wakes, and something beneath the tangled roots answers.
Your spell parts the roots. Cinder, a young copper dragon, is trapped there with a cracked wing. It watches as you lift the roots clear.

title: Across the Hollow
lines: Cinder leads you to Moonlit Crossing, where the bridge lies in pieces. Beyond it, a sealed gate bears the same mark as the scale.
You rebuild the bridge block by block. Cinder steadies a beam while your ward spell lights the runes above the hollow.
The gate opens when your light meets its mark. Cinder recognizes the rune and steps through first, toward the clock that broke its wing.

title: The Borrowed Hours
lines: In Amber Ruins, every leaf is frozen mid-fall. Golden threads run from Cinder's wing to a clock with no moving hands.
You sort the lost hours into place. The clock strikes once; its binding shatters, and Cinder spreads its mended wings.
The three seeds wake as time returns. Cinder lowers a wing, and you ride its warm updraft toward the lights of Dawnreach.

title: A Road for Everyone
lines: Cinder carries you to Dawnreach. Across the stream, your neighbors raise lanterns, but the road between you is gone.
You rebuild a crossing anyone can use. Cinder sends a ribbon of golden fire through each marker, lighting the safe path.
Your last spell carries the Core's light home. The mist lifts and your village returns. Cinder lands beside you as the road opens for everyone.
